prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Terbium (Tb) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a mine gallery of rough rock walls, timber props, an ore cart on its track and a line of hanging lamps
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: gothic lolita — a black-and-white lace jumper skirt with a bonnet; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing close to a high shelf or line, reaching up to it.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her — her own right hand under the right side of the box, her own left hand under the left side.
EXPRESSION: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — terbium: a soft silvery-grey metal named in 1843 for a piece of the name of Ytterby, a Swedish quarry village, a name later swapped by mistake with erbium's; its ions glow a brilliant yellow-green under ultraviolet light or electron beams, the green of three-band fluorescent lamps beside europium's red and of X-ray screens; alloyed with iron and dysprosium as Terfenol-D it stretches and shrinks in a magnetic field so strongly that it drives underwater sonar and turns a table or a window into a speaker — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: User selected 3,3,3; commit and non-force main update authorized

observations: Two raised arms support one box at high shelf; hands partly occluded by box with natural grip, no extra limbs; gothic outfit and reference freckles retained.
